title: Celestial Dream Mask
description: A realistic sculpted mask of a serene human face is covered in intricate hand-painted cosmic artwork. The design features swirling galaxies, stars, crescent moons, stylized blue and yellow waves, pink bears, and a small castle on the right cheek against a dark gradient background.
